title: Restart cart-redis and warm the cache
steps: 1. Check redis memory. 2. Restart the pod. 3. Run the cache warm-up job.

title: Roll back the last deploy
steps: 1. Find the last deploy. 2. Run the rollback pipeline. 3. Watch error rate for 10 minutes.

title: Raise payment-db connection pool and roll back
steps: 1. Roll back the payment-db config deploy. 2. Set max_connections back to 200. 3. Restart payment pods.

title: Rebuild catalog-db index
steps: 1. Put catalog in read-only mode. 2. Rebuild the products index. 3. Clear the catalog cache.

title: Drain and restart message-queue
steps: 1. Pause email consumers. 2. Restart the queue. 3. Replay the dead-letter queue.

title: Fail over orders-db to replica
steps: 1. Promote the replica. 2. Point services to the new primary. 3. Rebuild the old primary.
